title: Composed Evidence Graph
description: Schema for the additive, DISPLAY-ONLY composed index emitted at target_report.evidence_graph — the composed (target-level) analog of the per-subskill decision.headline.evidence_graph. It is a one-way projection over target_report: a `verdict` node (= target_call), one `skills[]` node per sub-skill short, and typed cross-lens `edges[]` (deciding_axis / dissent / modality_fit / risk / subtype_convergence) that REFERENCE existing target_report rollups by a `ref` path. It introduces NO new science, recomputes nothing, and feeds NO rule/resolver/gate (target_call owns the recommendation). Fail-soft: absent rollups yield empty node/edge lists. Edge endpoints are typed: a deciding_axis edge's `to` is a sub-skill short; a modality_fit edge's `to` is a modality channel and `from` the limiting sub-skill short; a risk edge's `to` is a governance dimension; a subtype_convergence edge's `to` is a molecular stratum id; a dissent edge's `from` is a signal source (not necessarily a sub-skill).
